title: Recompute nhẫn và đá, conflict minh bạch
prerequisite_policy: Evidence collection may be planned early; PASS requires every signed external gate and actual runtime tests; do not fabricate proof.
goal: Kiểm sự phụ thuộc ring ↔ gem ↔ setting ↔ cutter qua thay đổi tham số và history topology.
inputs: Actual checked-out Rust/OCCT source and runnable release artifact (not in planning ZIP)
Signed gate evidence, versioned fixtures, tolerance/performance budget from G00
execution_steps: Dùng fixture ban đầu, thay ring size/gem size/profile; thu feature DAG và old/new BRep IDs/labels.
Kiểm các dependent features recompute topo đúng hoặc báo conflict có vị trí và cách xử lý, không detach im lặng.
Undo/Redo thay đổi parameter và Save/Open; so scene graph, topological naming, geometry metric.
Nếu topology ambiguous, kiểm typed conflict thay vì tự nối sang mặt/edge sai.
negative_cases_and_blockers: Stale cutter/prong hoặc stable ID bị gán sai sau recompute: FAIL.
Auto-recompute không đủ evidence phải BLOCKED_REFERENCE thay vì PASS.
acceptance: All task-specific steps have reproducible actual vs expected evidence tied to source SHA, artifact hash, signed tolerance/fixture and environment.
Every negative case is run or explicitly BLOCKED with issue owner; no silent waivers.
Any issue requiring code changes is filed to the canonical owning module and re-tested, never implemented by M09.
PASS requires independent reviewer approval of this task evidence; agent cannot self-approve release gates.

test_plan.automated: Run relevant actual repo/CI tests identified after checkout, capture exact command/exit code; test descriptions above are required acceptance cases, not proof of existing test files.
test_plan.manual: Run exact UI, independent viewer or OS/GPU steps where listed; preserve tester identity and observed behavior.
test_plan.reference_oracle: Use signed G00 fixture/tolerance and approved OS/GPU/performance budgets; unavailable inputs => BLOCKED_REFERENCE.

implementation_scope: Release verification, independent evidence and signoff only. No release-owned CAD domain code, no rewriting Rust/OCCT/FFI from this task.
out_of_scope: Create duplicate L2/L3 or change canonical capability IDs
Alter OCCT modeling algorithms or user features under M01–M08 ownership
Assume 3DM export, clayoo/subd/tsplines, emboss, render or CAM belong to release scope
Declare manufacturing suitability or legally clear license without independent review
review_policy: No production/runtime claim without actual logs. Signoff by designated human release authority only.
source_basis: E09 History + E10 Gem + E11 settings contracts
specific_pass_oracle: Editing ring/gem dimensions recomputes dependent geometry correctly or returns an actionable conflict; topology naming never silently rebinds to the wrong entity.
